q: The degree of a rational map f: ℂ̂ → ℂ̂ is the number of preimages of a generic point. The Riemann-Hurwitz formula for a degree-d map with ramification gives:
opts: 2 − 2·deg(f) = χ(ℂ̂) − Σ(eₚ − 1) with eₚ the local degree at each ramification point
The number of critical points equals d
exp: Riemann-Hurwitz: 2−2g' = d(2−2g) − Σ(eₚ−1). For f: ℂ̂ → ℂ̂ (g = g' = 0): 0 = d·0 − Σ(eₚ−1), so Σ(eₚ−1) = 2(d−1). A degree-d rational map has exactly 2d−2 critical points counted with multiplicity.
